payload.summary: The General Fund half of Norwich's 2026-27 budget, put to Cabinet on 11 February 2026. It sets out what the council plans to spend and raise across every service, and a table towards the back splits the budget service by service. Licensing does not get a line of its own. It is folded into planning and regulatory services, budgeted at £5.4m of spending against £2.4m of income, leaving £3.0m to be met from council tax and government grant.
